detailed_descriptions.en: This game will test your patience , your phone skills , and your friendships . You can either: Play Solo - Master the flip, struggle your way up, and experience the story alone. Play Online CO-OP - Struggling together with up to 16 friends. No Legs. Just Flips. Rotate-Only Movement - Flippy doesn't have legs... Your only movements are rotation and a vibration jump. Hard Climb - Small mistake, big drop. 10 different areas and a clear goal - reach the top and reunite with your boy. Struggle Together Help Each Other - Use Beams and Microwaves to help your friends. Proximity Chat - Yell at your friends as everything goes wrong Get back to Jeff Little Jeff slipped on a strategically placed banana peel and accidentally yeeted Flippy into a storm drain... Now they're separated... Get your way back to Jeff for the happy ending they deserve! Chill Mode (optional) Want the story with less suffering? Play with checkpoints enabled and enjoy a more forgiving climb. Speedrun Friendly Quick restarts, built-in splits, and hard to master movement. And More! NPC Challenges – 16 different NPCs with challenges (side quests) that test your movement skills and reward only those who complete them. Fashionista Flippy – Customize Flippy with different phone cases, charms, stickers and more! Even a phone always wants to look its best. Do you Have Games on your Phone? – The answer is yes! Find, unlock, and play classic mobile games from the past. Truly a game-ception. WARNING! This difficult game tests your patience. Falling is part of the challenge. Will you RISE or QUIT when it gets tough?

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
This game will test your patience, your phone skills, and your friendships. You can either:

  • Play Solo - Master the flip, struggle your way up, and experience the story alone.

  • Play Online CO-OP - Struggling together with up to 16 friends.

No Legs. Just Flips.

  • Rotate-Only Movement - Flippy doesn't have legs... Your only movements are rotation and a vibration jump.

  • Hard Climb - Small mistake, big drop. 10 different areas and a clear goal - reach the top and reunite with your boy.

Struggle Together

  • Help Each Other - Use Beams and Microwaves to help your friends.

  • Proximity Chat - Yell at your friends as everything goes wrong

Get back to Jeff

Little Jeff slipped on a strategically placed banana peel and accidentally yeeted Flippy into a storm drain... Now they're separated... Get your way back to Jeff for the happy ending they deserve!

Chill Mode (optional)

Want the story with less suffering? Play with checkpoints enabled and enjoy a more forgiving climb.

Speedrun Friendly

Quick restarts, built-in splits, and hard to master movement.

And More!

  • NPC Challenges – 16 different NPCs with challenges (side quests) that test your movement skills and reward only those who complete them.

  • Fashionista Flippy – Customize Flippy with different phone cases, charms, stickers and more! Even a phone always wants to look its best.

  • Do you Have Games on your Phone? – The answer is yes! Find, unlock, and play classic mobile games from the past. Truly a game-ception.

WARNING!

This difficult game tests your patience.

Falling is part of the challenge.

Will you RISE or QUIT when it gets tough?
